cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'm here for the storeroom inspection. Please log my arrival and unlock it. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The manager signs at completion. Put the start time here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Mark the inspection suspended pending your call; she'll need the delay against your name.
